name: Time-Cut Flow Transport
novelty_claim: Proposed specific signed ownership-adjustment, temporal-cancellation, deadline-relaxed contrast, uncertainty-envelope and exact-removal synthesis; global novelty unproved.
economic_hypothesis: Overlapping opposite-signed known ownership adjustments can leave near-deadline pressure when time-feasible cancellation fails, after intermediary and implementation flexibility; price impact and market orders remain empirically unidentified.
target: Higher identical-window terminal fully funded net total-return wealth than both QQQ and SPY, plus positive incremental paired results versus exact same-cohort mechanism-removal controls.

account.dividends: actual entitlement and cash receipts, no double credit

universe.membership: point-in-time common stocks, permanent identities, subsequent delistings retained

input_contract.available_at: max actual required receipt, ingestion and ready times
input_contract.fund_holdings: received original prior-close physical quantities; current holdings cannot backfill availability
input_contract.index: original announcement/target/methodology version; distinguish effective open and preceding implementation close
input_contract.basket: holdings != published initial basket != actual negotiated custom baskets
input_contract.ETF_volume: secondary turnover is not primary cash flow
input_contract.N_CEN: annual AP roles and volume do not reveal daily AP inventory

formation.options_LETF: calendar baselines only, not primary invented physical mandates

ledger.fund_netting: net simultaneous changes within legal fund; incremental chronological target deltas, not repeated target minus present holding
ledger.future_sale_dependent_on_planned_purchas: exclude dependency chain from primary, not observed supply
ledger.bypass: cash/derivatives/basket relaxation reduce modeled demand, not fungible supply
ledger.cross_owner_matching: possible economic offset, never guaranteed internal crossing or desk right

kernel.method: per-security bipartite maximum flow with min-cut witness
kernel.allowed_edge: distinct legal owners, same permanent security, 0 <= demand_deadline - supply_release <= carry_limit
kernel.relaxed_debt: same graph with only time/carry restrictions removed
kernel.scenario_envelope: min/max across complete explicitly registered finite joint scenarios only

candidate.dimensions: shares times USD/share divided by USD/session yields session-equivalent liquidity

forecast.feature_preprocessing: train-only residualize added terms against BASE, train-only standardization
forecast.label: exact completed funded swap policy log-wealth advantage per initially reserved displaced QQQ dollar; net all costs, partial/missed fills, cash/settlement and terminal costs
forecast.whole_cluster: all securities/funds in same or overlapping implementation event
forecast.unfilled_stock_after_core_sale: Zero stock-trade contribution, but exact funded target includes actual cash yield, QQQ sale fees, missed QQQ return and restore costs; no zero account-advantage imputation.

sizing.priority: conservative net incremental log-wealth advantage; then prior ADV and permanent security ID

entry.core_sale_window: D+1 09:45-10:00 ET after D evening ticket
entry.stock_earliest: D+2 09:45-10:00 ET after actual QQQ sale settles
entry.refresh: new received inputs under frozen policy; vanished gap means abstain
entry.minimum_endpoint_remaining: one full session after actual entry

exit.ordinary: binding endpoint last ten to five minutes of continuous trading, known calendar; primary never assumes auction fill
exit.gap_fill: next obtainable price, losses beyond nominal stop retained
exit.halt: hold actual position with real marks until executable liquidation
exit.QQQ_restore: settled stock sale proceeds, next eligible 09:45 window
exit.unfinished_position_and_restore: retained in account NAV and terminal reserve

risk.resume: fixed quarterly review; no loss deletion
risk.feed_failure: cancel entries; reconcile and risk-reduce actual positions

controls: published reconstitution-game challenger where inputs permit

forward.family_correction: all five strategies and all registered challengers

blockers: original first-receipt historical physical fund holdings
bounded daily intermediary inventory and early-window estimates
fully executable quote/impact and broker settlement history
historical fund and security membership including delistings
reference_kernel_scope: pure supplied-graph correctness; no model fit, orders, account replay or market backtest
